title: Govern
description: The organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy are established, communicated, and monitored

title: Organizational Context
description: The circumstances surrounding the organization's cybersecurity risk management decisions are understood

title: Organizational mission understood
description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management

title: Internal and external stakeholders understood
description: Internal and external stakeholders, and their needs and expectations regarding cybersecurity, are understood

title: Legal and regulatory requirements understood
description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity are understood and managed

title: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services understood
description: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood

title: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on understood
description: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated

title: Risk Management Strategy
description: The organization's priorities, constraints, risk tolerance, and assumptions are established, communicated, and used to support operational risk decisions

title: Risk management objectives established
description: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

title: Risk appetite and risk tolerance established
description: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained

title: Cybersecurity risk management activities integrated
description: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes

title: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
description: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, managed, monitored, and improved

title: Supply chain risk management program established
description: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program is established by stakeholders

title: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers established
description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers and customers are established

title: Identify
description: The organization's current cybersecurity risks are understood

title: Asset Management
description: Assets — hardware, software, systems, facilities, services, people — that enable the organization to achieve business purposes are identified and managed

title: Hardware inventory maintained
description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

title: Software inventory maintained
description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained

title: Network communication and data flows mapped
description: Representations of organizational authorized network communication and internal/external network data flows are maintained

title: Asset prioritization
description: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission

title: Inventories of data and metadata
description: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained

title: Systems prioritization
description: Systems are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission

title: Risk Assessment
description: The cybersecurity risk to the organization, assets, and individuals is understood by the organization

title: Vulnerabilities identified
description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

title: Cyber threat intelligence received
description: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources
